overmanner.definition: adv. In an excessive manner; excessively.
overmanner.translation:
n. (尤指煤矿工业的)监工, 工头, 领班；[主苏格兰英语]仲裁人, 公断人；调解人
vt. 使超员, 给…配备过多人员(尤指服务人员)：

overmaster.translation: vt. 压倒, 征服, 打胜

overmastered.translation: v. 压倒, 征服, 制服( overmaster的过去式和过去分词 )

overmastering.translation:
a. <正>压倒, 征服

overmasters.translation: v. 压倒, 征服, 制服( overmaster的第三人称单数 )

overmatch.definition:
v. t. To be more than equal to or a match for; hence, to
   vanquish.
v. t. To marry (one) to a superior.
n. One superior in power; also, an unequal match; a contest
   in which one of the opponents is overmatched.
overmatch.translation:
vt. 优于, 胜过, 压倒
n. 高手, 劲敌, 实力悬殊的比赛

overmatched.translation: v. 打败( overmatch的过去式和过去分词 )

overmatching.translation: 打败( overmatch的现在分词 )；过匹配

overmatter.translation: n. (排版中)超出规定的字行

overmeasure.definition:
v. t. To measure or estimate too largely.
n. Excessive measure; the excess beyond true or proper
   measure; surplus.

overmen.translation: 工头, 师傅, 仲裁者( overman的名词复数 )

overmix.definition: v. t. To mix with too much.

overmodest.definition: s affectedly modest or shy especially in a playful or provocative way
overmodest.translation: a. 过分谦虚的, 过分羞怯的

overmountain.translation: a. 位于山上的,住在山上的

overmuch.definition:
s. very great in quantity; overabundant
r. more than necessary
overmuch.translation:
a. 过多的, 过度的
adv. 过度地
n. 过量, 超额
